KittyLM smoke corpus. Hand-written for engineering smoke tests only (Apache-2.0).

KittyLM is a small language model built to be understood. A tokenizer turns text into
tokens, a model predicts the next token, and a training loop makes the prediction better.
The smoke test checks that every part of the model runs on the GPU and that the model can
memorize this short text. It is not an experiment and says nothing about model quality.

def fibonacci(n: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return the first n Fibonacci numbers."""
    values = [0, 1]
    while len(values) < n:
        values.append(values[-1] + values[-2])
    return values[:n]


def is_prime(n: int) -> bool:
    """Return True if n is a prime number."""
    if n < 2:
        return False
    for divisor in range(2, int(n**0.5) + 1):
        if n % divisor == 0:
            return False
    return True


def count_tokens(text: str) -> int:
    """Return the number of whitespace-separated tokens in the text."""
    return len(text.split())

model:
  name: nano
  layers: 4
  heads: 4
  context_length: 256
  precision: bf16
